title: Car shares – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Car shares
hero.lead: A car share always belongs to a specific calendar event. In the event details, the car icon indicates whether a ride is available and whether seats remain.

body:
Open the car shares for an event

  1. Open the relevant event in the calendar.
  2. Select the car icon to the right of the time. It only appears if you are allowed to view the car shares for this event.
  3. Its colour shows the current status: the icon is subdued when no ride has been offered, green when seats are available and red when all rides are full.

Read driver, seat and passenger details

Each offer shows:

  • the driver’s name,
  • the total, available and occupied seat counts,
  • an optional note from the driver,
  • the names of passengers who have already booked.

Offer a ride

  1. Select Offer a ride in the dialogue. This action is unavailable for a cancelled event.
  2. Under Number of seats, enter at least one passenger seat.
  3. If necessary, add information such as the departure point or time under Note.
  4. Select Offer. Cancel or the X closes the form without saving.

Book a seat

  1. Open the car shares for the event.
  2. For an offer with an available seat, select Book seat.
  3. After a successful booking, your name appears in the passenger list and the available-seat count decreases.

You cannot book a seat in your own ride. If you are already a passenger, Kaderblick shows the cancellation action instead. Booking is disabled when no seats remain.

Cancel your booking

Select the remove icon or Cancel booking for your booking. Your name is then removed and the seat becomes available again. Bookings cannot be changed for a cancelled event.

Manage a ride you offered

  • As the driver, use the remove-person icon to remove a passenger from your ride.
  • The bin icon at the top right of your offer withdraws the entire ride.
⚠️
Withdraw a ride immediately
The bin icon withdraws the ride immediately; in the verified view, no additional confirmation dialogue appears.

Notifications

Kaderblick provides separate notification types for car shares, bookings, cancelled bookings and withdrawn rides. In your profile, choose which ones you receive by push notification or email.
